> “From thence ... to **Sir W. Montagu’s chamber** to have sealed some writings…”

According to Pepys’s diary, he appears in every December record except in December 1668, where his name is absent.

- **Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich** (27 July 1625 – 28 May 1672) – English military officer, politician and diplomat **who served as a naval officer**【12†L52-L62】.  
- He was a first cousin of John Pepys, the father of Samuel Pepys, and **a central figure in Pepys' diary**【12†L409-L416】.  
- Pepys’ diary is a major primary source for **Montagu’s naval career in the 1660s**【12†L416-L423】.

The naval figure mentioned in every December entry of Samuel Pepys’s diary, except for December 1668, is **Edward Montagu, 1st Earl of Sandwich** (known at the time as Lord Sandwich).

* Pepys’s diaries for 1660–1667 and 1669 similarly contain references to “Lord Sandwich” or “Montagu”, indicating his regular presence in Pepys’s life, while the December 1668 entries omit any mention of him, as noted by historians analysing Pepys’s writing【1†L569-L576】.
